Package org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.openlineage

Class OpenLineageIcebergCommitReportOutputDataSetFacetMetrics

java.lang.Object
org.odpi.openmetadata.frameworks.integration.openlineage.OpenLineageIcebergCommitReportOutputDataSetFacetMetrics
public class OpenLineageIcebergCommitReportOutputDataSetFacetMetrics extends Object
This class represents the commit metrics reported by Apache Iceberg for a write to a table. It is part of the OpenLineage spec.
